text: During the evening peak, cap passenger pickup wait at 15 minutes.
For shared rides, a passenger's time in the vehicle must not exceed the direct ride by more than 50 percent.
Allow no more than two separate passenger parties in a vehicle at any time.
Put six vehicles into service for this operating window.
Treat an unserved shared request as equivalent to two hours of passenger delay when evaluating the policy.
Cap pickup wait at 10 minutes, allow at most two parties per vehicle, and limit additional onboard time to 40 percent of the direct ride.
We expect an airport surge. Use eight vehicles, cap pickup wait at 12 minutes, and keep detours below 30 percent.
Limit pickup waiting to 600 seconds and additional onboard time to 25 percent of a direct trip.
Pooling should remain attractive, but not at any cost. Cap additional onboard delay at 40 percent and keep each vehicle to two parties.
晚高峰期间，每辆车最多承接两组乘客，接驾等待不超过10分钟，绕行时间不超过直达行程的40%。
本运营时段投入8辆车，接驾等待上限设为12分钟。
拼车不能以过度绕行为代价。每组乘客最多绕行直达时间的30%，同时服务不超过两组。
